method: Read-only audit of tracked changes and nonignored new files, strict JSON/duplicate-key and whitespace checks, acceptance/GUI/source/build/native hashes, status wording and historical preservation. No tests rerun, UI replay, proprietary execution, staging, commit or push. This report is the only new file written by this audit.
scope_limit: Prospective publication at listed hashes. Root owns later sealing/staging; this report and subsequent final-integrity/artifact-manifest/seal-revalidation records are outside the candidate inventory.

publication_candidates.inventory_definition: Sorted union of git diff --name-only -z BASE and git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z; path/bytes/SHA256 records; digest uses sorted keys and compact JSON separators.
publication_candidates.content_summary: Application source/tests, authored static findings/manifests/control scripts, numerical oracle, custody/review/status JSON and preserved status snapshots only. Vendor CPR/media, executable slices, provider captures, GUI captures and bundled build binaries remain local ignored evidence. Public SoXR source/licenses are unchanged from baseline.
publication_candidates.limits: Bounded path/content-key and pattern checks are not universal provenance or secret-detection proof.

whitespace.note: Added-file no-index exit1 with empty diagnostics is a difference, not a whitespace error. No upstream SoXR source changed.

corrections: REVIEW_PIN_KEYS now includes source_and_evidence, so this reviewer's Application file pins are checked by acceptance.
configured_integrity validates manifest external_references before recursive custody; it is called by both accept and seal.
Final-02 control output pins the corrected script and is referenced by accepted inputs. Earlier draft inputs and control results remain preserved.
sealer_review.limit: The ten synthetic controls validate the custody instrument; they are not additional application or target behavior tests.

limits_retained: Real CPR admission remains one verified zero-origin source event, separate from synthetic placed/gapped/multiple descriptor tests.
Original source rate is an explicit reconstruction context; the native hosted global/builder rate is not assumed to equal AudioFile rate.
Native provider/getter binding is static and conditional on the concrete captured classes; broader nonzero source-unit projection is gated.
Immutable full-read backend and Rebase block/worker/AVAudioEngine scheduling remain application choices.
Read retry/partition helpers are value operations; the app does not claim native I/O failures, mapping expansion or full-project playback.
GUI meters and endpoint displays are own-engine telemetry, not DAC output or target comparison.
scientific_wording.resolved_current_status_wording: Removed stale current project-media wording that called mode1 unimplemented; historical snapshots remain unchanged.
